lesion_mapping_status: HLHS23 + standalone TGA17 are definite harmonized CCHD and removed. TOF, unspecified PA, PS, CoA and TAPVR are conditional under the locked target and no participant-level <=28-day death/surgery/catheterization qualifier is reported; single ventricle, DORV, truncus, tricuspid atresia, cardiac mass, restrictive cardiomyopathy and subvalvular AS are not automatic harmonized CCHD. These 98 cardiac diagnoses therefore remain in the harmonized-CCHD-negative denominator.
management_actionability_evidence: The article identifies 247 additional babies with PPHN/sepsis/congenital pneumonia requiring increased monitoring or treatment. Sepsis definition includes antibiotics >=5 days; congenital pneumonia includes antibiotics >=5 days plus oxygen >=2 h. The group is therefore Strict CAN-CCHD; A-versus-B subtype is not fully separable for all 247 -> CAN-AB247. Cardiac diagnoses remaining in denominator lack subgroup-specific qualifying management evidence -> CAN-U98.
poolability_reason: complete 712-infant harmonized denominator, exact Strict and Expanded numerators, 100% terminal classification, nursery population with direct NICU exclusions

extraction_notes: Raw echo table sums exactly to 752. site_program: Muhimbili National Hospital and affiliated regular newborn nurseries, Dar es Salaam
screening_population: newborns >35 weeks in regular nurseries; severe illness/malformation requiring NICU excluded
screening_algorithm_raw: pulse oximetry screening followed by echocardiography for positive screens
study_target_definition_raw: study reports 15 CCHD among 49 echocardiographically evaluated positive screens
unknown_unascertained_n: 2 known pre-echo deaths plus unresolved status within 15 study-CCHD cases
diagnosis_categories_raw: study-defined CCHD; noncritical CHD; respiratory disorders; infections; normal; deaths before echo
diagnosis_counts_raw: 51 positive; 49 reached echo; source CCHD15; author-defined false positives34 = urgent intervention26 (noncritical CHD5, respiratory10, infections11) + normal8; two positive infants died before echo
individual_diagnoses: individual lesions among the 15 source-CCHD cases not reported in accessible main article; five noncritical CHD among the 34 false positives not lesion-specified
lesion_mapping_status: Harmonized CCHD count cannot be point-identified without the lesion identities of the 15 source-defined CCHD cases. Two final-failed infants died before echocardiography and cannot be silently assigned to either CCHD or CCHD-negative denominator. Confirmed author-defined CCHD-negative subset n=34 is valid for sensitivity only.
management_actionability_evidence: Among the 34 evaluated author-defined false positives, 26 had conditions explicitly described as requiring urgent medical intervention -> CAN-A26 within that confirmed subset. Eight were reported normal. No inference is made for the 15 source-CCHD cases or the two pre-echo deaths.
poolability_reason: study-defined confirmed CCHD-negative subset provides Strict 26/34, but lesion-level harmonized target mapping and two pre-echo deaths prevent a defensible primary point denominator
source_full_text_provenance: Majani NG et al. PLOS Glob Public Health. 2025;5(7):e0004904. PMID 40674358; PMCID PMC12270164; DOI 10.1371/journal.pgph.0004904.
extraction_notes: Preserve all 51 final failures. The authors excluded two babies who died before echo; Phase5 retains them as unascertained final fails. The 34 author-defined false positives are completely classified: 26 urgent-intervention conditions and 8 normal. Do not promote study-defined sensitivity 26/34 into the harmonized primary pool until raw lesions for the 15 source-CCHD cases are available.

site_program: Taipei City Hospital/participating Taipei newborn units
screening_population: all live newborns regardless of health status/location, including well-baby, intermediate care, special care and NICU
screening_algorithm_raw: pre/postductal pulse oximetry with repeat testing for borderline values and echocardiographic evaluation after final failure
diagnosis_categories_raw: source-CCHD; other cardiac problem; respiratory problem
diagnosis_counts_raw: source CCHD5 = d-TGA2, HLHS1, Ebstein1, DORV+single ventricle+TAPVR1; among 11 source false positives: PDA1 + respiratory problems10; 8/11 required further management
individual_diagnoses: d-TGA x2; HLHS x1; Ebstein x1; DORV+single ventricle+TAPVR x1; PDA x1; TTN/RDS/PPHN among respiratory group
lesion_mapping_status: Standalone d-TGA2 + HLHS1 are definite harmonized CCHD. Ebstein is not automatic. Complex DORV/single ventricle/TAPVR contains a conditional TAPVR component without documented <=28-day intervention/death and therefore remains in denominator under the locked target.
management_actionability_evidence: Eight of the 11 source-defined false positives required further management including oxygen/ventilator support -> CAN-AB8 exactly. The paper does not report whether the single PDA belonged to these 8 managed infants. If PDA was not managed: remaining source false positives = respiratory CAN-U2 + NON_CAN PDA1; with two re-entered cardiac CAN-U cases total CAN-U4 and Expanded12. If PDA was among the managed 8: remaining three respiratory cases are CAN-U and the two re-entered cardiac cases add CAN-U2, total CAN-U5 and Expanded13. Strict remains 8/13 in both scenarios.
poolability_reason: complete terminal classification and exact Strict count, but Expanded is bounded 12-13/13 and study population explicitly mixes well-baby and NICU/special-care infants without separable outcomes
source_full_text_provenance: Tsao PC et al. PLoS One. 2016;11(4):e0153407. PMID 27073996; PMCID PMC4830600; DOI 10.1371/journal.pone.0153407.
extraction_notes: Pilot period 2013-10-01 through 2014-03-31; later Taipei R029 begins 2014-04-01, so cohorts are sequential/non-overlapping but share program_cluster_id. Harmonized denominator13; Strict8/13 exact; Expanded12-13/13 depending whether PDA was among the 8 managed false positives. Mixed-setting flag independently prevents primary pooling.
